subject: Partner discovery recap + calendar lock for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@nimbuscloud.com>; sales@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner discovery recap & next step: technical deep dive

Hi Nora — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive: 

Recap (notes from our discovery):
- Primary use case: marketplace-led POC to validate private catalog + integrated billing.
- Key success metric: <50ms tail latency for 2k concurrent inference requests during peak test.
- Constraints: customer data residency (US), desire for Dedicated capacity with autoscaling.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (60 minutes): architecture, deployment model, and perf targets.
2) Pre-demo sync (30 minutes): owners + credentials + test corpus to validate latency.

Suggested windows (all PDT):
- Tue Oct 13: 09:00–11:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed Oct 14: 10:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Thu Oct 15: 14:00–16:00

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend (SE/Dev/PM). If helpful, I can send a calendar hold for the preferred window and include a short agenda.

Owners from Redwood:
- Technical demo lead: Camila Reyes
- Infra/SLA & deployment: Vivek Kulkarni

Prep items for the deep dive (we'll attach a one-page checklist):
- High-level topology / network constraints (VPN, peering)
- Expected QPS and token lengths for test corpus
- Any compliance docs we should review ahead of time

Attachments: redwood-marketplace-poc-checklist.xlsx (prep checklist), redwood-arch-overview.pdf (brief architecture).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—
Soojin Lee
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
